**Enlightening Experience at Ghorashal Power Plant \- EEE Department’s  Industrial Visit** 

We are delighted to share an exciting update from the Department of Electrical and Electronic  Engineering (EEE) at Sonargaon University\! On 12th February 2024, a group of enthusiastic  students embarked on an insightful industrial visit to the Ghorashal Power Plant, creating a  valuable experience for everyone involved. 

The industrial visit was organized and facilitated by the Department of EEE with the aim of  providing our EEE students with a practical understanding of the power generation processes,  operations, and the state-of-the-art technology employed at Ghorashal Power Plant. The visit  not only complemented the theoretical knowledge acquired in the classroom but also offered  a unique opportunity for students to witness real-world applications of their academic studies. 

![][image1]**Highlights of the Industrial Visit:** 

Interactive Sessions: 

Students engaged in interactive sessions with professionals and experts at Ghorashal Power  Plant. These sessions covered various aspects of power generation, including the plant's  architecture, machinery, and the role of technology in optimizing energy production. 

Guided Tour: 

A comprehensive guided tour allowed our students to explore different sections of the power  plant, from the turbine hall to the control room. This firsthand experience helped them grasp  the complexities of power generation systems and appreciate the meticulous planning  required for efficient operations.  
Q\&A Sessions: 

The students had the chance to ask questions and seek insights from the experienced  personnel at the power plant. This exchange of information fostered a dynamic learning  environment, encouraging our students to think critically about the challenges and  innovations in the power generation industry. 

![][image2]  
Networking Opportunities: 

The visit facilitated networking opportunities between our students and professionals from  Ghorashal Power Plant. Building such connections can be invaluable as our students prepare  to transition from academia to the professional world. 

![][image3]  
As we reflect on this successful industrial visit, we believe it has contributed significantly to  the overall development of our EEE students. The exposure to real-world applications and  the chance to interact with industry experts has undoubtedly enhanced their understanding  and enthusiasm for their chosen field. 

We extend our appreciation to the Ghorashal Power Plant authorities for their warm welcome  and the valuable experience they provided to our students. Additionally, they have assured us  that they are open to hosting both paid and unpaid internship positions for our students in the   
coming days. Such initiatives are integral to our Honorable Vice Chancellor’s commitment to  providing our students a holistic education that goes beyond the classroom. 

We look forward to more collaborative initiatives that bridge the gap between academia and  industry, preparing our students for successful careers in the dynamic field of Electrical and  Electronic Engineering.
